title: Bangers With Mashed Winter Squash and Fried Sage
description: This autumnal spin on traditional British bangers and mash is cooked almost entirely on one sheet pan, making it a hands-off, weeknight-friendly dinner.

ingredients.name: butternut squash
ingredients.quantity: 1 medium (about 2 pounds), peeled, seeded, and cut into 3/4-inch cubes

steps.instruction: Place the butternut squash on a sheet pan and drizzle with olive oil.
Season with 1/2 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper, then toss to coat.
Add the sausages to the pan, turning them to coat in the oil.
Roast for 30 minutes, tossing about halfway through, until the sausages are browned and cooked through.
Transfer the butternut squash to a bowl and mash with a potato masher.
Add the half-and-half, maple syrup, cayenne, and 1/4 teaspoon salt, then mix until smooth. Adjust seasoning to taste.
In a small skillet, melt the butter over medium heat until simmering.
Add the sage and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook until the garlic is golden, the sage is crisp, and the butter is browned, about 2 more minutes.
Remove from heat and transfer the fried sage leaves to a paper towel-lined plate.
Stir about half of the brown butter into the mashed squash until incorporated.
Serve the sausages with the squash mash, topped with fried sage and a drizzle of the remaining brown butter.
